idea: An open-source CLI that benchmarks AI agent frameworks — not models — against your real daily tasks, with human evaluation and per-category win rates.
why: Every benchmark compares models. Nobody benchmarks the full agent stack: the system prompt, tool routing, memory architecture, and infrastructure. Two frameworks pointing at the same LLM produce wildly different results. AgentAssistBench runs your actual prompts through multiple OpenAI-compatible frameworks side by side, stores results in SQLite, and after 30 days tells you exactly which stack wins for each category of work you do.
